room_9_default.speaker: Time Knight
room_9_default.content: You're still here? I mean, we just met, but frankly, you should've escaped by now. I would have. Obviously. Do better, kid.

room_9_flower_planted.speaker: Time Knight
room_9_flower_planted.content: What, you needed some extra motivation from a plant? Couldn't figure it out, so needed some words of encouragement? Weak. I'd have escaped 3 times over by now.

room_24.speaker: Time Knight
room_24.content: Idiot, what're you still doing here? Haven't figured out where the exit is yet? It's laughable, really, I've actually been out of the dungeon since I last saw you, it's that easy for me. I bet you'll try walking on the spikes too. Idiot.

room_28.speaker: Time Knight
room_28.content: I just had a word with the Dungeon Master, and we both agree that you're an incompetent buffoon. Honestly, it's not even a hard dungeon, and yet you're here, waiting? You're a joke, honestly. My grandmother escapes dungeons better than you.

room_47.speaker: Time Knight
room_47.content: Congratulations, you found the Dungeon Master... AFTER A MILLENNIA! Frankly, I'm shocked he's even still alive down here with how long you took to arrive. Honestly, I'd have caught him before he had even taken off running, but obviously I'm a much superior specimen than yourself.

room_68.speaker: Time Knight
room_68.content: This course is child's play. For me at least, I'm sure it'll take you 30,000 attempts to beat it. Don't worry, I'll help speed up your attempts with this tip... give up. You suck.
